organizations.normalization_notes: The historical employer name is preserved. No modern successor is substituted, and the employment is not silently merged with Cogswell's later Northern Trust work.
Student attendance is modeled separately from employment. Tuck School attendance remains in the evidence note without being recast as an employer.
The Army is modeled as a military affiliation and never as a civilian employer. Entry grade does not prove later commissioned status.

affiliations.date_precision: A 1954 institutional notice says Cogswell joined Northern Trust in 1949 after ten years with First Boston. His identifier-matched Army record dates entry to 7 June 1943, and the later obituary documents wartime OSS service. First Boston is therefore the best-supported last civilian employer before Army service, but the source does not state the precise leave or separation date and its ten-year wording spans wartime service.
affiliations.research_notes: First Boston is published as the best-supported last civilian employer, not as an explicit immediate pre-OSS affiliation. No role title is transferred from the separate Army occupation code.
